annotations.title: Follow or unfollow an account on X

description: Follow ONE account from the brand’s X account, or unfollow it with undo:true. ONE ACCOUNT PER CALL, and only an account the user named: X restricts accounts that follow or unfollow in volume, so there is no list input and a brand is held to 20 follows and unfollows a day. A protected account gets a follow REQUEST that waits for its owner. Needs the follows.write permission: an X connection made before 2026-11-15 must be reconnected once under Connectors > X (the tool says so without calling X). Costs credits (X bills per API call).

account.description: which connected account: its @handle or id from list_connector_accounts; needed only when several are connected

username.description: the @handle, or its x.com profile link
